result:
Here's what I understand you want: when someone books a lane, the club texts them at 18:00 the evening before so they remember to come or free the lane for the waiting list. Anyone who ticked "no texts, please" gets no texts from the club, reminders included.

What I found in the booking app:

- **Nothing sends reminders today.** The club already texts its newsletter through an SMS provider, so reminders can go out the same way.
- **Nearly a quarter of members won't get reminded.** 23% of members have "no texts" ticked, so under this spec they get no reminder at all. If those members are as likely to forget as anyone else, a large share of no-shows would be untouched.
- **Email is only a partial fallback.** 61% of members have no email address on file, so emailing the "no texts" group would still miss many of them.

Correct me if I've got any of that wrong.

The question that most changes what gets built: for members who've said no texts, do you want them reminded some other way, such as email where we have one, or is it fine that they get no reminder?

Or if you'd rather I just dive in, say so.
